> CVE-2026-20320                        
  Cisco BroadWorks: Remote XXE Leak     
                                        
  Improper XML external entity parsing  
  lets unauthenticated network attackers
  extract internal configuration files  
  remotely. CISA adds flaw to the Known 
  Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
